title: Kashmir: Valleys, Lakes & Mountain Escapes
subtitle: Discover Kashmir through its peaceful lakes, mountain valleys, and unforgettable landscapes. From a Shikara ride on Dal Lake to the alpine beauty of Gulmarg, Sonmarg, and Pahalgam, enjoy a thoughtfully planned 5-day journey with comfortable stays, private transportation, and local support.
route: Srinagar Airport → Srinagar → Gulmarg → Srinagar → Sonmarg → Srinagar → Pahalgam → Srinagar Airport
highlights: ["A scenic Shikara ride on Srinagar's iconic Dal Lake","Explore Gulmarg's beautiful meadows and mountain landscapes","Experience the alpine beauty of Sonmarg","Discover Pahalgam's rivers, valleys and mountain scenery","Experience Kashmir's traditional houseboat hospitality (subject to confirmation)","Enjoy a private, customizable journey with arranged local transport"]
included: ["4 nights' accommodation in agreed 3-star category hotels and houseboat (subject to confirmation)","Daily breakfast and dinner (MAP meal plan)","Srinagar Airport pickup and drop","Private vehicle for scheduled transfers and sightseeing","One-hour Shikara ride on Dal Lake","Specified Mughal Garden entry tickets","On-ground assistance throughout the journey"]
notIncluded: ["Airfare or other travel to and from Srinagar","Gulmarg Gondola tickets and optional adventure activities","Local union taxis required for certain sightseeing locations","Lunch, snacks and beverages not covered by the meal plan","Pony rides, snow activities and personal expenses","Anything not specifically mentioned in the inclusions"]
